fusions.name: Grasping Swarm
fusions.desc: A cloud of locusts pours from your open hands and strips everything within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each enemy. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Strips one of your afflictions off the target for 9 damage, adding 1.2 times its remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Fistful
fusions.desc: You strip a fistful of the crops nearby and eat it, restoring 25 stamina.

fusions.name: Never Full
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
